messages.subject: Project Aquilo - advice on Calderwater's mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin, Rebecca, Martin,

Attached is our advice note on Calderwater's v2 mark-up, with recommended landing positions. Headlines:

- Liability: resist the 150%/uncapped approach; offer a fixed £4m aggregate cap with a £5m IP sub-cap and LDs inside the cap
- Shortfall: reject deletion; offer to move from 15% to 8%
- Payment: hold 45 days
- LDs: restore 0.5%/week, 10% cap and the sole-remedy wording
- Warranty: hold 24 months
- Termination for convenience: resist; hold post-year-3, 6 months' notice

Can we have a quick call Wednesday to confirm instructions?

Best,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0021
whitfieldcarter.com

Agree with all of it. £4m fixed cap is much easier for us to insure and explain to the board than a percentage. Hold the 45 days firmly - 60 days would cost us materially on working capital. We can give them 8% on the shortfall but no lower. Wednesday 3pm works.

Rebecca
